notes: CRM notes - Cedarbridge (FS, EU HQ). Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS and strict data residency in eu-west-1. They run AML/risk-monitoring workloads (embeddings + reranking) where data cannot leave EU. Key items discussed: - SIG/CAIQ: Cedarbridge sent partial CAIQ. They expect completed CAIQ back plus clarifications on a handful of control responses (data deletion, third-party subprocessors). - Shared responsibility: they require explicit matrix stating Redwood handles runtime, OS patching, model weights, but customer controls keys, network, and ingress policies. We drafted matrix and will formalize during security deep-dive. - KMS integration: customer-managed CMK in AWS KMS preferred. Need to validate key policies and cross-account grants; SE to provide example IAM policies. - Audit logging: retention 1 year minimum, logs exported to customer S3 account via cross-account role. Need to confirm log schema and proof of immutable storage. - Data residency & egress: VPC endpoints only, no public egress for inference payloads; strict egress controls required. - Compliance artifacts: SOC2 Type II in progress; Redwood to provide encryption in transit/at-rest docs, pen test summary, and CAIQ responses. - Performance: target 150ms median token latency for chat workloads; throughput 200 req/s for embedding batch jobs overnight; cost sensitivity medium-high (want unit cost estimates for private pool). - Demo feedback: liked canary rollouts and fallback to smaller model variant if capacity constrained. - Quotes: Cedarbridge wants 3-year reserved capacity for predictable pricing; procurement timeline aligned with legal signoff (forecast 2026-05). Quotes sent - see drive deck.
